final_answer: There is no scientific link between the MMR vaccine and autism. The 1998 study suggesting such a link was fully retracted and found to be fraudulent, with its author losing his medical license. The original claims have been thoroughly debunked by extensive research across thousands of studies worldwide involving millions of children. Major health organizations globally—including the WHO, CDC, NHS, and Cochrane Collaboration—confirm MMR is safe and does not cause autism.
